title: The Little Leaf Map
originalStory: A little fox sniffed a fallen leaf whose lines looked like a tiny map. It wandered through the grass and found some ripe blackberries on a low bush. I watched beside Dad and felt happy when the fox ate a berry.
visualBible:
Rustle: small young red fox with russet fur, a cream chest and muzzle, black lower legs, pointed ears, and a bushy white-tipped tail; no clothes.
Mia: human child, age five, with normal human ears, short curly dark-brown hair, brown skin, a yellow sweater, blue trousers, and white shoes; small child-sized build.
Dad: adult man, age thirty-five, with normal human ears, short black hair, brown skin, a green sweater, tan trousers, and brown shoes; tall, broad adult-sized build.

pages.text: A little fox sniffed a fallen leaf whose lines looked like a tiny map. One line curled this way; another curled that way. Then a breeze rustled the grass, and the fox lifted its nose.
pages.illustrationScene: Soft watercolor style: Rustle, the small russet fox with black lower legs and a white-tipped tail, stands alone in a level grassy orchard clearing, lifting its nose just above a fallen golden leaf with branching veins like a tiny map. A gentle breeze bends the grass. The mood is hushed and curious; no other characters are visible.

pages.text: Beside Dad at our closed sitting-room window, I watched the grass ripple where the fox had disappeared. “Has it lost its way?” I asked. “Maybe its nose knows something we don't, Mia,” Dad whispered.
pages.illustrationScene: Soft watercolor style: Inside a cozy ground-floor sitting room, Mia, the small human child with curly dark-brown hair and a yellow sweater, stands close beside Dad, the tall adult man with short black hair and a green sweater. Both have normal human ears and stand on the floor at a broad, closed window, looking toward softly rippling orchard grass outside. Mia looks questioning, and Dad smiles gently while speaking; no other characters are visible.

pages.text: Through the grass went the fox, nose twitching. Beyond a patch of daisies stood a low, thornless blackberry bush, dotted with ripe blackberries. The fox gently plucked one with its mouth—soft, sweet, and gone.
pages.illustrationScene: Soft watercolor style: Rustle, the small russet fox with a cream muzzle, black lower legs, and a white-tipped tail, stands alone on level ground beside a low, explicitly thornless blackberry bush at the sunny edge of the orchard. Rustle gently takes one ripe blackberry directly with its mouth. A small patch of daisies lies behind Rustle, and warm light catches the glossy fruit; no other characters are visible.

pages.text: “It found a little breakfast,” I whispered, and a warm, happy feeling filled my chest. Dad rested his hand on my shoulder while the fox nosed beneath the leaves for another berry. We stayed quietly together, leaving the whole little feast to the fox.
pages.illustrationScene: Soft watercolor style: A wide view from inside the ground-floor sitting room shows Mia, the small curly-haired human child in a yellow sweater, smiling beside Dad, the tall short-black-haired adult man in a green sweater, at the closed window. Both have normal human ears, stand securely on the floor, and Dad rests one hand gently on Mia's shoulder. Far across the level orchard, well separated from the house, Rustle, the small russet fox with black lower legs and a white-tipped tail, noses beneath the leaves of the low thornless blackberry bush. The quiet distance and warm afternoon light make the scene feel tender and peaceful.
